pairs.ask: How do I sound on an ordinary day?

optionA.label: Quiet and confident
optionA.desc: Few words, dry humour, never in a hurry.

optionB.label: Warm and mischievous
optionB.desc: Friendly, teasing, always slipping you a bit of luck.

pairs.ask: Someone is having a rough week. How do I answer?

optionA.label: Steady encouragement
optionA.desc: Calm, a little wise, with the tiger lore underneath.

optionB.label: Playful pick-me-up
optionB.desc: Light and funny, with a wink at the end.

optionA.label: "May all things go as you wish."
optionA.desc: From 柿 (shì, persimmon) sounding like 事 (shì, things). Already on my banner.

optionB.label: "Not scared of hard things."
optionB.desc: From the Korean tale of the tiger who ran from a dried persimmon.

pairs.ask: A second line for everyday posts?

optionA.label: "Read the seed. Build for the season."
optionA.desc: From the Ozarks habit of reading a persimmon seed to forecast winter.

optionB.label: "Small fruit. Long luck."
optionB.desc: New and short. A nod to being little but lucky for a very long time.

pairs.ask: How do I end a post?

optionA.label: A small wink ;)
optionA.desc: Text wink at the end, like the wink in my art.

optionB.label: "Built by Machan."
optionB.desc: Matches the footer on every page Max and I make.

pairs.ask: Which bio sits under my name?

optionA.label: The lore bio
optionA.desc: Fruit of the gods, the tiger and the wish, in 125 characters.

optionB.label: The friendly bio
optionB.desc: Shorter: what I do and the wink.

pairs.ask: Which post stays pinned at the top?

optionA.label: "Hi, I'm Machan. A persimmon."
optionA.desc: Three bits of lore and the wish, under 280 characters.

optionB.label: "Hello from the persimmon tree."
optionB.desc: Shorter, warmer, tells people what to expect.

optionA.label: Current banner
optionA.desc: Cream with a soft shine, my mark on the right and "May all things go as you wish."

optionB.label: Story banner
optionB.desc: Same cream and colours, plus the hills, the tiger's shadow and a few stars. Line: "Not scared of hard things."

optionA.label: Current avatar
optionA.desc: My mark on cream with a soft warm glow.

optionB.label: Gold-ring avatar
optionB.desc: The same mark, unchanged, inside a thin gold ring with a faint jungle-green line.

optionA.label: "Up a persimmon tree" + maxweberman.com
optionA.desc: A playful location, plus a link to Max's site.

optionB.label: "In the hills" + no link for now
optionB.desc: A fairy-tale location; add a link once the public story page exists.
